attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's EC-7, adopted. Stated as a `reset` cell — a NEGATIVE obligation — on the objectives quantity of reload-model and replace-model, and negative obligations are the ones that need a control: a check reporting `not inherited` for everything discharges the cell while enforcing nothing. So each carries the positive control that an objective explicitly declared inheritable IS inherited, and check-mosaic.mjs §10 refuses a `reset` cell without one. That is the R6 incident-closure lesson relocated: 17 registered mutations each carry a positive control because a closure predicate that refuses everything closes every incident.

attrs.statement: A successor does not inherit a predecessor's objectives merely because a capability the predecessor created survived. Objective inheritance requires an explicit inheritance record; capability continuity is not one.
